title: Edamame and tofu rice bowl
summary: Edamame and tofu rice bowl is a japanese dinner built around firm tofu and frozen edamame beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook firm tofu for Edamame and tofu rice bowl in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm basmati rice alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss frozen edamame beans with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Edamame and tofu rice bowl straight away. Taste Edamame and tofu rice bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
